def VTask_ofLeftInverse {α : Sort u_3} {β : Type u_4} (f : α → β)
    (f_inv : Nonempty α → β → α) (hf : ∀ (h : Nonempty α), Function.LeftInverse (f_inv h) f) :
    α ≃ ↑(Set.range f) := by
  -- When α is empty, both sides are empty, so the equivalence is trivial
  -- When α is nonempty, we can use the left inverse to construct the equivalence
  -- The forward map sends a to ⟨f a, ⟨a, rfl⟩⟩
  -- The backward map sends ⟨y, ⟨x, h⟩⟩ to x
  -- The proofs that these maps are inverses follow from the left inverse property
  exact
    if α = ∅ then
      Equiv.empty α (Set.range f)
    else
      Equiv.ofInjective f
